approval_context: Response to: Geef je akkoord om Stronger Performance Energy als korte ritmische preview te laten renderen?
scope: Read current state and newer evidence before execution. Reuse existing detector/analysis, source hash binding, V06 and prepared template. No new detector or full-song rerender.

Create an isolated project copy and render one 24-second private Stronger Performance Energy preview after musical timing, take-specific lipsync, expression and safe-crop validation. Use exact policy events as a proposal, not proof of kick/snare identity or vocal climaxes.

Resolve collisions and frame quantization with existing rules; make only bounded safety/timing adjustments within the selected treatment and document them. Do not imply that Nitin approved exact unreviewed events or final style.
Do not infer bar one from every fourth beat. No bar-phase-dependent emphasis unless verified; true bar-one alignment is not required for event-based preview.

Keep captions as an independently authorized workstream. Local executor may diagnose existing Montserrat/Cinzel availability and activate already-authorized project fonts using supported access; escalate genuine installation permissions or licence issues only. Do not silently substitute fonts.
Serialize Resolve UI/render access across agents. Caption font issues must not block a text-free rhythm preview. Keep the existing source audio unchanged.

Technical QC: full decode, actual minimum 10-bit HLG metadata, audio/lipsync, peak crop, clear face/mouth and motion recovery. Obtain independent Gemini visual/music QC where available and report limitations.
Persist private review video/project/config and SHA manifests to authoritative Shared Drive, narrow code/evidence to GitHub. Return verified review link and exact scope of executed work.
Keep Master State unchanged if ledger/reducer integrity checks fail. Record append-only task evidence without editing frozen history or manufacturing approvals.
